Field.Name: Shop Name

Field.RangeHint: How close a customer's token must stand to the shopkeeper to press the trade key.
Field.MusicHint: Loops for the customer while the shop window is open.

Field.BuyBackHint: Customers may sell back any item this shop has for sale.
Field.HoursHint: Off by default. When on, players can only trade between these real-world times (each player's own clock; trades are checked against the GM's clock). Ranges past midnight work, e.g. 22:00–02:00.
Field.VagueStockHint: Players see words instead of numbers: Only one left (1), A few left (2–4), Small amount (5–9), Decent supply (10–19), Plenty of stuff (20+). You still see the exact count.

DL.Title: DogmaLiter Connection

Menu.Name: DogmaLiter
Menu.Label: DogmaLiter Account
Menu.Hint: Log in to DogmaLiter and link your Foundry characters to your DogmaLiter characters. Money changes are written to the web characters and items can be sent to their web inventories.

DL.LoginHint: Log in with your DogmaLiter account. The password is not stored; the login is kept only in this browser.
DL.SendConfirm: Send {item} to the DogmaLiter inventory of {actor}? It will be removed from this character.
DL.Sent: Sent {qty}× {item} to the DogmaLiter inventory of {actor}.

Error.NotLoggedIn: You are not logged in to DogmaLiter (Actors sidebar → DogmaLiter).
Error.SessionExpired: The DogmaLiter login has expired. The GM needs to log in again.
Error.NoGame: No DogmaLiter game is chosen for this character. Link it again in the DogmaLiter window.
Error.NoCharacterId: {actor} is not linked to a DogmaLiter character. Link it in the DogmaLiter window (Actors sidebar).
Error.NoItemId: {item} has no Item ID. Set it on the item sheet.
Error.MoneySync: Could not update {actor}'s money on DogmaLiter: {error}
Error.GMNotLoggedIn: The GM is not logged in to DogmaLiter, so items can't be sent right now.
Error.MoneyLoad: Could not load {actor}'s money from DogmaLiter: {error}

DL.GameHintGM: Your choice is also the default game for this world.
DL.LoadMoney: Load the money from DogmaLiter into this actor when linking
DL.PickCharacter: Choose the DogmaLiter character to link the selected actor to:
DL.NoCharacters: You have no characters in this game.
DL.ChooseGameFirst: Choose a game to see your characters.
DL.Unlinked: {actor} is no longer linked to DogmaLiter.

ApiUrlSetting.Name: DogmaLiter API Address
ApiUrlSetting.Hint: Address of the DogmaLiter server, e.g. https://api.dogmaliter.online (with or without /api). After changing it, everyone needs to log in again.

DL.ServerHint: Server: {url} (GM: Game Settings → DL_shop → DogmaLiter API Address).

DLImport.Title: Import from DogmaLiter

Menu.Name: DogmaLiter Import
Menu.Label: Import Items
Menu.Hint: Import items from your DogmaLiter game's compendium into the world's “DogmaLiter Items” compendium (hidden from players). They keep their DogmaLiter ID, so they can be sold in shops and sent back to the web inventory.

DLImport.Hint: {total} items in “{game}”. Click items to select them; the selection is kept across pages and searches.
DLImport.InFoundryHint: Already imported — importing again updates the Foundry item instead of making a copy.

ImageFolder.Name: DogmaLiter Image Folder
ImageFolder.Hint: Folder (in Foundry's Data folder) where images of items imported from DogmaLiter are saved.

DLImport.ImagesTo: Item images are downloaded to “{folder}” (Game Settings → DL_shop → DogmaLiter Image Folder).
DLImport.ImageFailures: {n} image(s) could not be downloaded; those items use a placeholder image (see the console for details).

Approval.Title: Send to DogmaLiter?
Approval.Text: {user} wants to send {qty}× {item} from {actor} to the DogmaLiter inventory of {character}.
Approval.Waiting: Asked the GM to approve sending the item…
Approval.Declined: The GM declined sending {item} to the DogmaLiter inventory.
Approval.AlreadyWaiting: {item} is already waiting for the GM's approval.
Approval.Gone: The item no longer exists, so nothing was sent.

DLSHOP.OutsideHoursGM: Outside opening hours ({from}–{to}) — only you can trade now.
DLSHOP.HistoryHint: Last {n} trades, newest first (up to 500 are kept).
DLSHOP.ClearHistoryConfirm: Delete the whole purchase history of {shop}?

HoursSetting.Name: Pulled Item Active Time (hours)
HoursSetting.Hint: How long an item pulled from a DogmaLiter bag stays active in Foundry (real time). After that it is inactive until the GM reactivates it.

Pull.Hint: The character's bag on DogmaLiter (equipped items are not listed). Pulling MOVES the item into Foundry — it leaves the website — and keeps it active for {hours} (h:mm). After that it is inactive until the GM reactivates it.
Pull.NotLinked: {actor} is not linked to a DogmaLiter character.
Pull.Confirm: Pull {item} ×{qty} into {actor}? It will be removed from the bag on the website and stay active for {time} (h:mm).
Pull.InactiveHint: Time is up: this item is inactive until the GM reactivates it.
Pull.ActiveHint: Pulled from DogmaLiter: time left before it becomes inactive (h:mm).
Pull.ActiveUntil: Pulled from DogmaLiter — active for another {time} (h:mm).

Error.NoPack: The DogmaLiter compendium does not exist yet. The GM creates it with the first import.
Error.ImportFailed: Could not import {item} into the DogmaLiter compendium.
Error.GMNotLoggedIn: The GM is not logged in to DogmaLiter, so items can't be pulled right now.
Error.NotInBag: That item is no longer in the bag on DogmaLiter.
Error.InactiveUse: {item} is inactive. Ask the GM to reactivate it.
Error.InactiveSell: {item} is inactive and can't be sold.
